allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless the complete source justifies B. Ten listed bodies cannot each manufacture an original-owner Bonus Action,offense allowance,phase or resource. Select exactly who issues a command,who pays any real cost,and how incompatible owner/controller instructions arbitrate. Use actual complete companion source profiles for positive cases; hypothetical CR or attack values cannot clear a content hold. Preserve outside-initiative spent budgets on transition.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target forgets who they are; cannot act for3rounds (NO ACTION,WIS NEGATES EARLY),while Core lists1Action casting.
allQuestions.options: A: no action describes the victim denial or no-cost ending save,retaining the caster Action. B: free casting as an explicit conflicting-source interpretation.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Preserve both originals and spell out the selected reading; parenthetical wording must not silently grant free rank9 casts. Clarify whether application has an initial WIS in addition to early ending saves or automatic initial denial under real admission. A 26RP/Action commitment still pays on a resisted or prevented effect.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Cannot act and forgetting identity do not enumerate Action,BA,Reaction,movement,speech or stored class knowledge.
allQuestions.options: A: a named three-round denial component plus a separately defined temporary identity-belief overlay. B: another exact component model preserving both printed benefits.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define the denial fully without casually reducing it to ordinary Incapacitated or silently adding paralysis,all-save failure or death. If Incapacitated is actually selected,its concentration consequences follow; otherwise no assumed concentration loss. Keep class ownership,RP,inventory,memory originals and real person identity. The name EraseSoul does not destroy a soul,change Hunt finality or grant resurrection prevention.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: WIS negates early and3round duration lack exact save opportunities and final ordering.
allQuestions.options: A: one WIS at each affected regular END,with a three-future-regular-END maximum under the native hostile clock. B: a different explicit early-save cadence.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an explicit clock matching the accepted control framework,including any affected current-END save and final expiry order. Define whether success ends both denial and identity overlay. Attached phases need a real source-specific bridge; out-of-initiative behavior cannot create new budgets. Suppression preserves deadlines and scheduled saves; gaining an immunity suppresses only covered components and cannot refund hard history or restore previously lost concentration.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: CREATURES must bow/worship or be frightened; Core120ft range,concentration1minute and AppropriateSavingThrow leaves area/count/save open.
allQuestions.options: A: a disclosed fixed or following field with a defined radius,one initial WIS per recipient. B: a finite selected creature list and exact resistance policy.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on geometry and selection;120ft is casting range,not automatically radius or unlimited world reach. Specify actual perception/LoE,friend/self inclusion,first exposure,cover,entry/exit and consciousness if an aura. NEW radius and save choices must be visible in decisions; do not silently reduce plural creatures to one target.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The actual alternative is BOW AND WORSHIP YOU OR BE FRIGHTENED,not simple unconditional fear.
allQuestions.options: A: each affected target/controller chooses actual outward submission versus the named Frightened effect. B: automatic submission with an explicit resistance/alternative mechanism.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserving a real target choice. Define bowing anatomically without automatically importing Prone,full Action loss or kneeling capability; if Prone is selected,apply its genuine movement/stand rules. State worship conduct and action/speech demands. Compelled performance establishes no sincere faith,deity identity,permanent loyalty or true cosmological authority. No extra hidden penalty replaces a forbidden or impossible posture.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Choice frequency,fear immunity,submission interruption and suppression could otherwise create forced fallback or repeated hard admission.
allQuestions.options: A: fixed per-application decision with expressly stated later change conditions. B: fresh choices at specified real opportunities without refreshed resources.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the timing and whether a fear-immune creature can choose an ineffective fear branch. Immunity is not automatic forced worship. If submission actually denies a whole Action,define establishment-time hard admission independently; no delayed claim after a soft branch was admitted. Describe own attacks,standing/departure,damage,repeat saves if NEW and independent CalmEmotions suppression. Do not reset histories on cover or reentry.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: One creature is stunned,silent,defenseless FOR FULL DURATION UNLESS DAMAGED; Core says Instantaneous.
allQuestions.options: A: an explicitly NEW finite maintained duration,for example one minute,with a selected concentration policy. B: an enduring effect until its printed damage break/removal with full persistence rules.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must select a real useful duration. Instantaneous cannot silently erase the promised continuing benefit. If an initial save is added,state ability and success outcome as NEW; do not add repeated escape saves merely because another control spell uses them. Preserve the full-duration-unless-damaged clause and distinguish other universal endings such as actual dispel/death.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: STUNNED,SILENT and DEFENSELESS are three printed clauses; Stunned permits only faltering speech but does not itself mean silent.
allQuestions.options: A: native Stunned plus separately source-bound silence and a concrete defensive-permission reduction. B: a different disclosed component completion preserving every clause.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define defenseless explicitly: which Guard/cover/AC/Reaction/defense permissions change and which remain. No automatic critical hit,zeroAC,loss of armor/resistance or instant death is printed. Use actual components so Stun-only or Silence-only immunity affects only its scope. Stun can end concentration at actual application; later immunity does not restore it. Do not treat the separate silence clause as redundant and discard it.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: UNLESS DAMAGED needs exact break timing after mitigation,tempHP and damage sharing.
allQuestions.options: A: break after this recipient actually takes positive source-qualified damage,including tempHP absorbed,under its complete damage pipeline. B: a different explicit qualifying-damage boundary.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a named actual-damage predicate,not hit alone or a predefense roll. Fully prevented damage and pure HP cost are distinct; decide whether a positive packet at an HP floor with zero actual loss qualifies. The triggering attack uses defenses valid at its own snapshot,then cleanup occurs at the selected post-damage checkpoint. Redirected-away damage cannot falsely wake the original body; an actual incoming transfer must be evaluated under its own real event. Keep one Wound/root history and no duplicated packet.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Independent immunity,suppression and later damage interact with one application and spent hard history.
allQuestions.options: A: one application with independent established components and a common actual damage-ending event. B: separately ended components with an explicitly justified relationship.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select whether qualifying damage during suppression still ends the underlying spell; suppression is not removal. Define initial blocked hard component versus any meaningful printed silence/defense remainder,without inventing a substitute. Different-caster overlap,removed components,expiry and already-ended callbacks must not resurrect effects or refund admission. A fixed full-duration effect has no hidden repeat save unless the conference expressly chooses one.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Declare ONE CREATURE'S NEXT ACTION; it must succeed INT or do it. No action category or communication channel is specified.
allQuestions.options: A: one concrete legal ordinary Action declared before the initial INT save. B: broader next-action vocabulary with each controlled budget explicitly listed.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a clear Action object and real targets/method choices,not a vague prediction that guarantees success. Decide hearing/understanding versus a new mental channel. Attack,spellcasting,consumables,limited abilities,secret disclosure,self-harm and known duty violation require a source-specific conduct decision. Availability comes from actual repertoire/resources; the caster gains no free hidden-state test.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Next action could mean the next ordinary Action,an inserted-turn Action,an extra Action or any small interaction.
allQuestions.options: A: next qualifying genuine ordinary Action opportunity with an expressly fixed finite marker. B: the very next committed matching action across explicitly listed budgets.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose the exact opportunity without importing regular-only Command timing automatically. Do not let the target evade a compelled ordinary Action by voluntarily refusing to act unless that is the chosen policy. No out-of-turn Action or BA/Reaction expenditure is created. Reserve actual hard control at establishment and preserve other mandatory instructions,spent budgets and real incapacity. Extra turns do not refresh ordinary resources.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core Instantaneous leaves an unperformed future Action pending without a defined expiry or suppression policy.
allQuestions.options: A: expiry after the original next qualifying opportunity,with a bounded elapsed fallback for genuine absence. B: a different explicit finite deadline.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require a useful positive execution before typed expiry rather than a phase-zero cancellation of its own opportunity. If the actual Action becomes unavailable,illegal or blocked,define failure/expiry without replacing the command or creating resources. An attached creature needs a real phase and budget; an expiry-only marker creates neither. Completed acts persist as actual history; ending the instruction cannot undo damage,payments or completed world changes.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Control BATTLEFIELD by REDIRECTING ATTACKS and BLOCKING MOVEMENTS for1minute; Core120ft casting range and no concentration.
allQuestions.options: A: a fixed explicitly dimensioned zone with both active functions and nonconcentration minute. B: a following zone or concentration version as a disclosed addition.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the actual substantial battlefield area,height,center range,LoE and eligible creatures rather than treating120ft as automatic radius. Both functions must be useful. Select owner awareness and command timing,any Action/Reaction charge and event frequency openly; a one-use or one-creature limiter is not recovered source. Realm is a control field,not a new cosmological plane.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Redirecting attacks lacks target-commitment window,range/source eligibility and result reuse.
allQuestions.options: A: before attack RNG,retarget one eligible committed attack to a new actually legal recipient while preserving original actor and paid action. B: a stated post-roll redirect with full recalculation and disclosure policy.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless the conference deliberately chooses the stronger post-roll power. Define melee/ranged/spell attacks,each Multiattack member,beneficial attacks,area spells and unseen actors. A new target must satisfy selected source geometry/eligibility; identify any explicit override rather than assume one. Retain original attack/damage provenance,resources and one hit/Wound resolution; no new cast/counter window or ownership flip. Reaction cost,if any,is NEW and must not quietly neuter the printed field.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Blocking movements leaves voluntary steps,forced displacement,teleportation and current in-flight motion distinct.
allQuestions.options: A: prospective denial of actual eligible movement segments before committing them. B: a physical/source-owned barrier with complete body geometry.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select exact movement scope and cost/refund consequences; do not equate a rule denial with solid matter or automatically stop teleportation without a new explicit clause. State step boundaries,continuous motion,falling,forced movement,leaving the field and bodies already crossing its edge. No retroactive occupied illegal space,crushing damage or reset of spent movement. Blocking movement alone is not necessarily whole-Action denial,Speed0 or Root.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Competing realms,other redirectors and repeated input events can reroute forever or expose hidden actors.
allQuestions.options: A: stable original-event IDs with deterministic opportunity order and one finite consumed decision per actual event. B: another bounded routing model with explicit terminal outcomes.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on which legal redirect wins and what the final attack/movement does; a loop-rejection guard alone is not a complete positive effect. Preserve useful control without multiplying charges on duplicate callbacks or granting free recasts. State interaction with actual reflected spells,damage-sharing stages and control instructions. Record only source-authorized player information; rendering,debug data and an unavailable prompt cannot disclose hidden enemies.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target BELIEVES IT HAS ALWAYS SERVED YOUR CAUSE after failed CHA; the source does not rewrite actual history.
allQuestions.options: A: a full subjective service/loyalty overlay with defined accessible autobiographical reconciliation. B: an explicitly wider memory rewrite with bounded content and preserved originals.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exactly what the target believes and remembers,what contradictions remain,and how a cause is concretely identified. Preserve the strong always-served promise without substituting a minor friendly attitude. No real past service,asset ownership,achievement,faction record or completed crafting is fabricated. Target and caster gain no unknown historical facts or hidden cause-membership oracle.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core Instantaneous leaves whether the belief is a lasting completed mental change or an ongoing removable enchantment unresolved.
allQuestions.options: A: a continuing nonconcentration overlay with an explicitly selected finite or indefinite lifetime. B: an instantaneous completed belief change with separately specified restoration rules.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose persistence,dispel/antimagic behavior,contrary-evidence recovery and exact memory-restoration interface. A short one-turn duration would materially reduce the printed premise and needs justification. No unsupported universal curse tag or automatic RemoveCurse cure. Preserve original identity and prior memories once; duplicate/replaced overlays cannot overwrite the true restoration baseline or rewrite earlier independent memories.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Belief in lifelong service can affect behavior but does not expressly grant direct orders,alignment changes,real faction standing or oath immunity.
allQuestions.options: A: genuine target decision-making from the specified altered belief with no automatic domination. B: a precisely authored additional command component,with its admission and action limits.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A while making behavioral consequences concrete and useful: how duties,recognized allies,contrary causes and personal boundaries are evaluated. External reputation/membership,Paladin oaths and actual class access stay their real records unless expressly changed by a separate rule. Genuine resulting acts still have ordinary consequences. Resolve multiple casters/causes,immunity,restoration and post-expiry knowledge without silently granting protected secrets or bypassing control admission through the label belief.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Native each-turn saves, next Action compulsion, controlled commands and event redirection authorize different opportunities; current Control15/Time5/Transport6 do not create a generic extra turn or shared resource pool.
allQuestions.request: Use exact current scoped sources and complete actual actor histories. Demonstrate Absolute Domination on a genuinely inserted turn with its printed END save, a ten-body Dominate Legion roster with independent saves/endings and two real companions sharing one owner, and Prophecy Fulfilled with an actual usable next Action before expiry. For command/redirect conflicts select a deterministic terminal result and show the original budgets, actor ownership and source restrictions remain; a rejected loop alone is not proof of useful control.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: These sources combine separately meaningful identity belief, denial, outward conduct, silence, defense and damage-break clauses. One generic mental or Stunned flag loses native distinctions.
allQuestions.request: Provide separate actual and subjective state records with complete original memory preservation. Show Erase Soul identity overlay and denial ending together or separately under the selected rule, genuine worship-versus-fear choice including fear immunity and nonkneeling anatomy, all three Mesmerize components with exact actual-damage break checkpoint, and useful lifelong-service belief without fabricated institutional history. Existing source-qualified immunity/Calm Emotions/True Seeing/restoration affects only its authorized components; no lost concentration, spent action or prior memory is silently restored.

requiredNewCases.requiredEvidence: Actual Wizard17 target/control cast on source-qualified nonhumanoid with no inventedCRcap, full authority/channel and native one-minute concentration, actual inserted-turn ENDWIS escape.
Real attached companion phases/owner budget, lost command channel and used hard-control history, ongoing original clock with no banked new denial.
Actual one-sentence useful multistep instruction beyond one-word Command, selected duration/task grammar and real recipient capabilities/budgets through initialWIS.
Impossible or resource-dependent wording and competing mandate, actual paid Ready target-at-release and no hidden-state retarget or infinite obedience by punctuation.
Ten fully source-qualified actual fixture recipients, one real paid cast with independent saves/initiatives/commands and meaningful simultaneous control.
Two real companions sharing original-owner limits, independent endings and changed control/cross-caster conflict, no replacement slot or recreated phase/resource.
Actual CoreAction/26RP cast and distinct temporary identity overlay plus complete cannot-act component, full native three-round schedule and retained actual memories.
EarlyWIS success through suppression, separately scoped immunity and original deadlines, no soul destruction or restored lost concentration/Actions.
Actual plural recipient geometry and native minute concentration, useful genuine outward submission versus Frightened choice with defined conduct/action cost.
Fear-immune and nonkneeling body, changed choice/cover/reentry and actual Calm Emotions scope, no compulsory sincere theology or delayed hard-admission claim.
Actual selected full lifetime with native Stunned plus silence and substantive defenseless clause, genuine initial source-qualified admission and old concentration ending.
Full prevention versus tempHP/redirected-away/incoming-transfer damage, exact break checkpoint during suppression and no repeat-save or auto-critical imported by name.
Actual declared next legal Action after failedINT with real attack/check/resource outcome, source-qualified opportunity before selected finite expiry.
Earlier mandate/unavailable costly source and inserted/attached opportunity distinctions, no free turn, hidden resource oracle or replacement declaration after failure.
Actual maintained battlefield with both a useful legal redirected attack and blocked movement, true pre-RNG or selected decision window and original source budgets.
Multiattack member, illegal retarget, forced movement versus teleport, two competing realms with finite terminal result and exactly-once input/history.
ActualCHA-governed lifelong-service belief and concrete useful resulting decisions, complete original autobiographical state and externally unchanged institutional facts.
Contradictory evidence/actual restoration and later incompatible cause, selected persistence/suppression with real consequences of resulting acts and no invented direct command authority.

originalFutureCaseRequirementsUnchanged: For every identity, supply at least one source-qualified positive full encounter and an adverse meaningful branch,with actual acquired class/repertoire,initial RP/HP,Dissonance,components,actions,perception,positions,source DC/RNG,intermediate control budgets and final state. Source fixtures,not invented creature ratings or attacks,establish eligibility.

AbsoluteDomination: a legal non-humanoid without an invented CR cap; initial save and an actual inserted-turn END escape; valid versus lost mental channel; an attached companion with genuine original-owner phases; repeated hard-denial history.

CommandReality: a useful full sentence beyond a one-word order; a multi-step task at the selected duration boundary; invalid/resource-dependent wording; competing mandatory commands using one actual budget; Ready release with current target information.

DominateLegion: ten real distinct recipients with different saves,initiatives and independent endings; two companions sharing one original owner; no free replacement slot,duplicate command or refreshed outside-initiative budget.

EraseSoul: Core Action payment versus the no-action interpretation; three original hostile deadlines; early WIS success during suppression; distinct identity/denial immunity; old concentration not restored after a real loss.

OverwhelmingPresence: actual submission and actual fear alternatives; a fear-immune target; a creature without ordinary kneeling anatomy; cover/entry/exit and changed choice at defined markers; CalmEmotions suppressing only fear.

PerfectMesmerize: all three useful components,Stun-only immunity,preexisting concentration ending,full-duration survival without damage,fully prevented hit,tempHP absorption,damage redirected away and actual incoming transferred damage. Show the precise break checkpoint.

ProphecyFulfilled: actual next legal Action with real attack/check outcome; an unavailable costly action; earlier conflicting mandate; an extra-turn or attached-phase boundary under the selected policy; finite expiry without invented opportunity.

PuppetmastersRealm: one meaningful legal redirected attack and one blocked movement in the maintained field; illegal alternative target,Multiattack member,forced movement/teleport distinction,two competing realms,duplicate callbacks and hidden actor information.

RewriteLoyalty: useful changed allegiance decisions with actual prior memories retained; contradictory evidence and restoration; incompatible later cause; real faction reputation/oath consequences remain objective; source-specific suppression versus ending behavior.

Across all cases, separate current authored acceptance,source integrity,conditional fixture arithmetic,real engine execution,human gameplay,balance,cosmology and release. No missing full positive example is cleared by a rejection-only guard.

scope: Preparation only. Current exact accepted contexts supersede old pending comparison labels within their scope. No new rule adopted. No supplied program execution or runtime/human/balance/cosmology/release claim.
